findings.summary: debounced() writes the launch stamp before spawn() is attempted; a failed spawn still blocks a retry for the whole interval.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.js: debounced() writes the launch stamp before spawn() is attempted; a failed spawn still blocks a retry for the whole interval.

findings.summary: Debounce limits launch frequency, not concurrency; long syncs or simultaneous sessions can overlap full index rebuilds.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.js: debounce limits launch frequency, not concurrency; long syncs or simultaneous sessions can overlap full index rebuilds.

findings.summary: parseKnowledgeSettings line reader misses flow-style YAML; such config is treated as files (fails safe) while pipeline-cli selects the remote backend.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.js: parseknowledgesettings line reader misses flow-style yaml; such config is treated as files (fails safe) while pipeline-cli selects the remote backend.

findings.summary: sessionStart runs on startup, resume, clear and compact, so the status line and its up-to-3s status call appear after every compaction and resume.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/context-surface.js: sessionstart runs on startup, resume, clear and compact, so the status line and its up-to-3s status call appear after every compaction and resume.

findings.summary: Status reports the previous sync's outcome; doc could say so.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.js: status reports the previous sync's outcome; doc could say so.

findings.summary: Timeout 5->10s leaves little margin over ~7s worst case plus Node start-up; still fails open.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/plugin.json: timeout 5->10s leaves little margin over ~7s worst case plus node start-up; still fails open.

findings.summary: The try/catch around knowledgeSessionSync in sessionStart() is never exercised; a throwing stub test would cover it.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/context-surface.js: the try/catch around knowledgesessionsync in sessionstart() is never exercised; a throwing stub test would cover it.

findings.summary: End-to-end test polls up to 2.5s for the detached stub; could be slow on a loaded CI runner.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.test.mjs: end-to-end test polls up to 2.5s for the detached stub; could be slow on a loaded ci runner.

findings.summary: lastError from cli-context status goes into systemMessage without a length cap or control-character stripping; not a vulnerability.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/hooks/lib/knowledge-sync.js: lasterror from cli-context status goes into systemmessage without a length cap or control-character stripping; not a vulnerability.
